verdict.rationale: Vendor marketing claims instant AI summaries of scanned mail and automatic AI labels and categorization inside the mailbox. That covers AI-generated insights from the user's own data, but there is no evidence of AI suggestions or recommended actions, and only one-line marketing mentions describe the feature. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended next actions, in-depth documentation of how summaries and labels work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
